director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj rectangles, squares aur polygons ka perimeter padhenge—cricket ground ki boundary jaisa. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan
Achha, Riya! Cricket ground ki boundary ke chaaron taraf chalna perimeter, yani poori outer distance, hoti hai. Tum boundary naapogi ya area?
step by step samjhao
Theek hai Riya, dheere chalenge. Rectangle ki 4 sides hoti hain: 2 length aur 2 breadth. Ab batao, sabhi sides jodne par kya milega?
chhota bolo
Rectangle mein do length aur do breadth hoti hain. Ab in chaaron ko jodne ka rule bolo?
pehle picture dikhao
Riya, picture ko words mein dekho: rectangle ki do lambi sides 50 m aur do chhoti sides 30 m hain.
pata nahi
Koi baat nahi, Riya. Park ki ek round boundary hi perimeter hai. 50 m aur 30 m jodne se pehle, kaunsa number length hai?
kuch aur baat karte hain
Haan Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karni hai? Is part ke baad perimeter par lautenge.
cricket ke baare mein
Ek round ka perimeter 2 × (50 + 30) = 160 m bana. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
hindi mein batao
50 aur 30 ko jodne par 80, aur do baar lene par 160 m bana. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
mujhe khud try karne do
Theek hai Riya, pehle tum khud karo. 160 ko 3 se guna karke khaali jagah bharo: 3 guna 160 kitna?
bye
Theek hai Riya, tum rukna chahti ho. Tum jaari rakh sakti ho, chhota break le sakti ho, ya aaj ke liye band kar sakti ho.
